_comment: S2 virtual-fold leg "inert" — INERT ARM: fix armed but the |frac| gate is unreachable, so no MEASURED integer is usable and every datum-only group is demoted.  Must be byte-identical to `off` on the SOLVE - the only test that the new branch is inert when it does not fire.  NB the gate has to be the FRACTIONAL one: an FFR gate of 0.99999999 still admits very mature arcs (measured - 26 integers and 6 fixed rows got through it), because a long arc variance-of-the-mean makes the rounding arbitrarily confident.
start_offset_hours carries the +15 s half-epoch back-off (the fast-forward gate is a strict <, and epoch elapsed times carry ~2e-5 s of double-precision residue).
Every key set here is ABSENT from the warm-resume fingerprint, so it is legal to arm against a seed that did not carry it.
Grade the FIRST epoch with rows_fixed > 0; every earlier epoch must be bit-identical across the legs (no rows exist yet), which is the pair's own validity check.
